page_title: BOC 0-5 BAY | Bochum v Bayern Munich 27/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+1' A cross into the box from Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) is cleared.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' One of the players from Bochum times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
88' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Patrick Drewes.
87' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
86' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
85' Peter Zeidler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mats Pannewig (Bochum) replacing Ibrahima Sissoko.
80' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
79' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. It will be a corner kick for Bayern Munich.
78' Substitution. Eric Dier has come on for Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich).
77' The attendance for today's match is 26000.
77' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Patrick Drewes is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
73' Bochum have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
71' Peter Zeidler has decided to substitute Dani de Wit and he is replaced by Koji Miyoshi (Bochum).
71' Peter Zeidler has decided to make a change. Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) replaces Moritz Broschinski.
71' 0 - 5 Goal! Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) is teed up on the edge of the box by Alphonso Davies, and his howitzer of a shot into the top right corner gives the keeper no chance. 0:5.
69' Here is a change. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Mathys Tel.
67' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) is penalised for a foul. Florian Exner had a clear view and blows his whistle.

65' 0 - 4 Goal! Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top left corner. Patrick Drewes had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:4.
61' Peter Zeidler decides to make a substitution. Tim Oermann (Bochum) will be replaced by Lukas Daschner.
61' Substitution. Joao Palhinha (Bayern Munich) makes his way off the pitch and Leon Goretzka comes on as his replacement.
61' Thomas Muller joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich).
61' Vincent Kompany prepares a substitution. Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is replaced by Leroy Sane.
57' 0 - 3 Jamal Musiala finds Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) with a sweet pass inside the penalty box, who then smashes the ball inside the left post. What a clinical finish to make it 0:3.
56' Dani de Wit (Bochum) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
56' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
54' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
54' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but his effort is straight at Manuel Neuer.
53' A dangerous free kick that is situated just outside the box will be taken by Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) who is well-known for his brilliant shooting technique.
53' Joao Palhinha (Bayern Munich) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Florian Exner stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Bochum earn a free kick.
52' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
51' Bayern Munich are ruled offside.
49' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
47' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Felix Passlack comes off for Cristian Gamboa (Bochum).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.

45' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
40' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, well to the right of the goal.
38' Corner kick. Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is ready to send the ball into the box.
37' Florian Exner blows his whistle after Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
36' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
33' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
30' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
29' Jakov Medic (Bochum) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
29' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Felix Passlack (Bochum).

26' 0 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) rises high inside the six-yard box to meet a cross by Joshua Kimmich from the free kick. He heads home into the middle of the goal, making the score 0:2.
26' It seemed like Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
25' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) brings an opponent down and Florian Exner interrupts the game. Bayern Munich have a free kick.
24' Erhan Masovic (Bochum) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
23' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

23' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Moritz Broschinski (Bochum). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Now Bochum have a corner.
21' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
21' The free kick from long range, taken by Bochum, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
20' Florian Exner interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich). Bochum are awarded a free kick.
19' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Patrick Drewes is equal to it and makes an easy save.

16' 0 - 1 Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) struck with a perfectly taken free kick from the edge of the box. He curled the ball straight inside the right post. There are not enough superlatives that can be used to describe that goal.
16' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position, just outside the box.
15' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) was too forceful with his tackle and Florian Exner interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Bayern Munich have a free kick from a promising distance.
13' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
12' Felix Passlack (Bochum) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florian Exner had an easy-decision to make.
6' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

6' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the bottom left corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
6' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
5' Poor challenge! Dani de Wit (Bochum) is penalised for tripping and Florian Exner blows his whistle.
1' The first half has just begun.
Bochum will kick-off.
Florian Exner got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
